increment_paragraph: **MEMBER-PATH-DIRECT-REFUSAL-TEXT** (rule 30 diagnostic text, contract specification §C04.19.6 note; [report](../../reports/member-path-direct-refusal-text/README.md)). The `member-path-direct` refusal of a direct call now names the clause beside the member-path states: a hand-off keeps "beside a hand-off, which only a callback invocation composes"; a helper destroyer (rule 50) reads "beside member invocations, which no direct call composes"; any other clause, which the loader does not admit, reads "beside a clause other than a plain predicate" (`member_path_direct_reason` in `legacy_callback_route.rs`). When the refusal fires, its code and every verdict are unchanged. The only semantic content change is `mk_http_thread_destroy`'s refusal at `mk_http_thread.c:269`; `mk_rconf_read`'s reading-site evidence differs only by the build commit it spells. The pinned corpus and `measure --declared` were not run (no user namespaces, and the corpus preparations are deleted).
